table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name
table:columns.description: The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop (Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, EuroCrops). ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: coverage
table:columns.description: Land-cover category (Grass land, Arable field, Ditch, Landscape element) (source column `category`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: An identifier for the field. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:code
table:columns.description: The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop. The first 4, 6, 8 digits select increasingly specific crop groups. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name_en
table:columns.description: The original crop name translated into English. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

chips.title: Chip definitions with field coverage

table:columns.name: gzd
table:columns.description: MGRS grid zone designator of the chip's grid cell

table:columns.name: mgrs_10km
table:columns.description: MGRS 100 km square plus 10 km cell identifier the chip belongs to

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: chip identifier; matches the STAC item id (with the year suffix stripped)

table:columns.name: field_coverage_pct
table:columns.description: percent of the chip's area covered by mapped field polygons

table:columns.name: hcat_dominant_code
table:columns.description: EuroCrops HCAT code of the crop covering most of the chip's fields

table:columns.name: hcat_dominant_name_en
table:columns.description: English name for hcat_dominant_code

table:columns.name: hcat_dominant_pct
table:columns.description: share of the chip's field area under the dominant crop

table:columns.name: hcat_top
table:columns.description: the crops covering the chip's field area, as {code, name_en, pct} entries ordered by share (top 5)

table:columns.name: split
table:columns.description: which benchmark split the chip belongs to (train / val / test)

table:columns.name: admin0_iso3
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country: the unit containing the chip's centre, or the one it overlaps most when its centre is in none (FAO GAUL 2024); GAUL gives disputed areas its own x-prefixed codes such as xJK

table:columns.name: admin0_name
table:columns.description: country: the unit containing the chip's centre, or the one it overlaps most when its centre is in none (FAO GAUL 2024)

table:columns.name: admin1_name
table:columns.description: first-level administrative unit (state, province, region): the unit containing the chip's centre, or the one it overlaps most when its centre is in none (FAO GAUL 2024)

table:columns.name: admin2_name
table:columns.description: second-level administrative unit (district, county, department): the unit containing the chip's centre, or the one it overlaps most when its centre is in none (FAO GAUL 2024)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: the chip footprint, a square polygon in EPSG:4326

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: bounding box of the chip footprint

chips.description: One row per chip: its grid location, how much of it is mapped field, its dominant crop, administrative unit and the benchmark split it is assigned to.

items.description: Every chip's STAC item, mirrored into one GeoParquet file (STAC-GeoParquet) so the collection can be queried without walking the catalog tree.

chips_tiles.title: Chips (PMTiles)
chips_tiles.description: The chip grid as PMTiles vector tiles, for fast map rendering of the chip boundaries.

fields_tiles.title: Field boundaries (PMTiles)
fields_tiles.description: The field boundary polygons as PMTiles vector tiles, for fast map rendering of the fields.

style-split.title: Chips by split
style-split.description: MapLibre style: chips coloured by their train / validation / test split assignment.

style-field-coverage.title: Field coverage
style-field-coverage.description: MapLibre style: chips shaded by the share of their area covered by mapped fields.

style-dominant-crop.title: Dominant crop per chip
style-dominant-crop.description: MapLibre style: chips coloured by the crop covering most of their field area.

style-crops.title: Crops
style-crops.description: MapLibre style: fields coloured by their harmonized crop (EuroCrops HCAT).

style-outline.title: Field outlines
style-outline.description: MapLibre style: every field in one colour, for reading the boundaries themselves.

field_embeddings.title: Per-field embedding statistics (AlphaEarth Foundations, OlmoEarth v1.3)
field_embeddings.description: Mean and standard deviation of each embedding dimension over each field's pixels, for 2024; joins onto the fields by `id`. AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset by Google and Google DeepMind, CC-BY-4.0 (source of the aef_* columns). OlmoEarth v1.3 embeddings by Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI), OlmoEarth Artifact License, including its Section 2 use restrictions (source of the olmoearth_* columns).

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Field id; joins onto the `fields` (or `fields_filtered`) table.

table:columns.name: pixels
table:columns.description: Number of 10 m pixels used for this field's embedding statistics.

table:columns.name: pixel_rule
table:columns.description: How pixels were selected for this field: `centroid` (pixels whose centre falls inside it) or `touched` (every pixel the field touches, for a field too small to contain a pixel centre).

table:columns.name: aef_pixels
table:columns.description: Number of pixels the AlphaEarth Foundations product covered for this field (can differ from `pixels` where its coverage is partial).

table:columns.name: aef_mean
table:columns.description: Mean of each AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dimension (64 values) over the field's pixels. AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset by Google and Google DeepMind, CC-BY-4.0.

table:columns.name: aef_std
table:columns.description: Population standard deviation of each AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dimension (64 values) over the field's pixels.

table:columns.name: olmoearth_pixels
table:columns.description: Number of pixels the OlmoEarth v1.3 product covered for this field (can differ from `pixels` where its coverage is partial).

table:columns.name: olmoearth_mean
table:columns.description: Mean of each OlmoEarth v1.3 embedding dimension (the first 64 of 128 dimensions) over the field's pixels. OlmoEarth v1.3 embeddings by Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI); OlmoEarth Artifact License, including its Section 2 use restrictions.

table:columns.name: olmoearth_std
table:columns.description: Population standard deviation of each OlmoEarth v1.3 embedding dimension (first 64 of 128) over the field's pixels.
